```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(here)

source(here("Ghasemi_analysis", "R", "setup.R"))
source(here("Ghasemi_analysis", "R", "functions.R"))

```

## Import current object

```{r}

sample_files <- list.files(
  path = here("Ghasemi_analysis", "results", "sample_results"),
  pattern = "_object_with_decontX\\.rds$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

sce <- readRDS(file = here("Ghasemi_analysis", "data", "hum_sce_final.rds"))

counts <- assay(sce, "umi")
labels <- sce$cell_type

```

## Processing

```{r}

# create empty pseudobulk matrix

celltypes <- sort(unique(labels[!is.na(labels)]))

pb_counts <- matrix(
    0,
    nrow = nrow(counts),
    ncol = length(celltypes),
    dimnames = list(
        rownames(counts),
        celltypes
    )
)

# loop through each cell type

for (i in seq_along(celltypes)) {
  ct <- celltypes[i]
  
  print(paste0("Aggregating ", ct, "..."))
  
  keep <- !is.na(labels) & labels == ct
  
  pb_counts[, i] <- Matrix::rowSums(
    counts[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  )
}

# now we have pseudobulk matrix
# log2 normalize to match author

celltype_sizes <- colSums(pb_counts)

cpm_matrix <- sweep(pb_counts, 2, celltype_sizes, FUN = "/") * 1000000

log2_cpm_matrix <- log2(cpm_matrix + 1)

cb_ref <- SingleCellExperiment(
  assays = list(logcounts = as.matrix(log2_cpm_matrix))
)

colData(cb_ref)$celltypes <- colnames(log2_cpm_matrix)

# ----------------------------
# CHANGE ENSG ID to Gene Name

rownames(cb_ref) <- gsub("\\..*", "", rownames(cb_ref))

# 1. Generate matching gene symbols
gene_symbols <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = rownames(cb_ref),
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  column = "SYMBOL",
  multiVals = "first" # Drops duplicates by keeping the first match
)

# 2. Handle missing mappings (replace NA with the original ENSG ID)
na_mask <- is.na(gene_symbols)
gene_symbols[na_mask] <- rownames(cb_ref)[na_mask]

# 3. Handle duplicate gene names (SingleCellExperiment requires UNIQUE row names)
# This appends a suffix like .1, .2 to duplicate symbols
unique_gene_names <- make.unique(as.character(gene_symbols))

# 4. Assign the new gene names back to your reference object
rownames(cb_ref) <- unique_gene_names

ctrlName <- "cb_reference_annots"

# Remapping Cell Types to Broader Categories

# celltype_map <- c(
#   astroglia = "Astrocytic",
# 
#   meningeal = "Perivascular/Stromal",
#   `mural/endoth` = "Perivascular/Stromal",
# 
#   oligo = "Oligodendrocytes/OPCs",
# 
#   immune = "Monocytes/Endothelial",
#   erythroid = "Monocytes/Endothelial",
# 
#   GABA_MB = "Malignant Cells",
#   GC = "Malignant Cells",
#   `GC/UBC` = "Malignant Cells",
#   glut_DN = "Malignant Cells",
#   glutamatergic_uncertain = "Malignant Cells",
#   interneuron = "Malignant Cells",
#   isthmic_neuroblast = "Malignant Cells",
#   noradrenergic = "Malignant Cells",
#   NTZ_mixed = "Malignant Cells",
#   NTZ_neuroblast = "Malignant Cells",
#   UBC = "Malignant Cells",
#   VZ_neuroblast = "Malignant Cells",
#   GABA_DN = "Malignant Cells",
#   `isth_N` = "Malignant Cells",
#   parabrachial = "Malignant Cells",
#   Purkinje = "Malignant Cells"
# )

# cb_ref$celltypes_coarse <- dplyr::recode(cb_ref$celltypes, !!!celltype_map)

for (inFile in sample_files) {
  
  print("========================================")
  print("Processing file... ")
  
  base_name <- basename(inFile)
  sID <- str_remove(base_name, "_object_with_decontX\\.(rds|Rdata)$")
  
  print(paste0("Load sample: ", sID))
  
  sObj <- readRDS(inFile) 
  
  expr_mat <- tryCatch(
    {
      LayerData(sObj, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")
    },
    error = function(e) {
      GetAssayData(sObj, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")
    }
  )
  
  input_tumor <- SingleCellExperiment(
    assays = list(logcounts = expr_mat)
  )
  
  print(paste0("Running SingleR against: ", ctrlName))
  
  pred.cb <- SingleR(
    test = input_tumor,
    ref = cb_ref,
    labels = cb_ref$celltypes,
    assay.type.test = "logcounts",
    assay.type.ref = "logcounts"
  )
  
  # -----------------------------------------
  # Store labels back in Seurat metadata
  # -----------------------------------------
  sObj$SingleR_label <- pred.cb$labels
  sObj$SingleR_pruned <- pred.cb$pruned.labels
  
  sObj$cell_type <- pred.cb$labels
  sObj$filtered_ct <- pred.cb$pruned.labels
  
  # -----------------------------------------
  # Output filenames
  # -----------------------------------------
  out_dir <- dirname(inFile)
  
  resName1 <- file.path(
    out_dir,
    paste0(sID, "_singleR_", ctrlName, "_check.pdf")
  )
  
  resName2 <- file.path(
    out_dir,
    paste0(sID, "_UMAP.", ctrlName, "_SingleR.pdf")
  )
  
  resName3 <- file.path(
    out_dir,
    paste0(sID, "_SingleR_", ctrlName, "_ann.txt")
  )
  
  resName4 <- file.path(
    out_dir,
    paste0(sID, "_object_with_SingleR.rds")
  )
  
  # -----------------------------------------
  # Diagnostic SingleR plots
  # -----------------------------------------
  pdf(resName1, width = 8, height = 6)
  print(plotScoreHeatmap(pred.cb))
  print(plotDeltaDistribution(pred.cb, ncol = 3))
  dev.off()
  
  # -----------------------------------------
  # Plot labels on UMAP if available
  # -----------------------------------------
  if ("umap" %in% names(sObj@reductions)) {
    p <- DimPlot(
      sObj,
      reduction = "umap",
      group.by = "SingleR_pruned",
      label = TRUE,
      repel = TRUE
    )
    
    pdf(resName2, width = 8, height = 6)
    print(p)
    dev.off()
  } else {
    print("No UMAP found; skipping UMAP SingleR plot.")
  }
  
  # -----------------------------------------
  # Save annotation table
  # -----------------------------------------
  pred_df <- as.data.frame(pred.cb)
  pred_df$cell <- rownames(pred_df)
  
  write.table(
    pred_df,
    resName3,
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  # -----------------------------------------
  # Save updated Seurat object
  # -----------------------------------------
  saveRDS(sObj, resName4)
  
  print(paste0("Finished sample: ", sID))
  
}


```
